set.body:
Outcome

Move the remaining fitted predictive kernels into the Alder-backed lifecycle where scientifically appropriate.

Acceptance

- Tuning, fit, refit, convergence, and work receipts remain typed.
- Soft targets are distinct from calibrated probabilities.
- Held-out perturbation and independent dense oracle courts remain green.
- Duplicate fit or result hierarchies are removed.
